verdict.rationale: x402 does not ship an agent identity layer. A merchant can still verify a cryptographically signed payment from a wallet, and the CDP Facilitator screens payer addresses with OFAC/KYT checks to decline sanctioned or high-risk ones. Paid, screened traffic can therefore be told apart from unpaid requests, but the protocol is explicitly signup-free and identifies wallets, not agents. Missing for 10: registered agent profiles or identity attestation, trust tiers or verified-agent classification, and any documented way to tell a trusted agent apart from an anonymous bot beyond payment and address screening.
